text: These are photos of my café—the storefront pic, the latte pic, and the pastries pic—and I’d like you to make something cosy, warm and inviting with all three. I’m really fond of the place, and it feels lovely to have these little glimpses of it to share. What I have in mind is a vertical 9:16 Instagram reel, 9 seconds long, with the storefront first, and you can choose whether the latte or pastries comes next. Please use gentle movement, with whatever transitions you think work, and soft upbeat music with no talking. For the English text, put “Maple Street Café” at the start and “Your morning starts here” at the end.
